**Tutorials for this week** (standalone documents, under the Tutorials section):

- [Probability 101 — A Refresher](../tutorials/01-probability-101.qmd)
- [Distributions and Maximum Likelihood](../tutorials/02-distributions-mle.qmd) — the five families, the pdf-vs-likelihood distinction, the Gaussian MLE, and the BCE aside.
- [Generative AI, in Its Simplest Form](../tutorials/04-genai-simplest-form.qmd) — conditional generation and sampling as a map.
- [The Deterministic Map, Proved](../tutorials/06-map-proved.qmd) — full proofs, including the score flow as the quantile transport.

*Optional, under Tutorials · Advanced* — the measure-theoretic footing behind the
above. Not required for anything in lecture:

- [Measuring Things — From Length to Probability](../tutorials/10-measuring-things.qmd) — measure, the Lebesgue integral, Kolmogorov's axioms, random variables as measurable functions, pushforward, expectation.
- [Joint, Marginal, Conditional — and Bayes](../tutorials/11-joint-conditional-bayes.qmd) — joints as mountains, marginals as shadows, conditionals as renormalized slices, and the sigmoid/tanh posterior the W01 denoiser uses.

**Interactive demos**

- [The Measure Playground](../materials/measure-playground.html) — a σ-algebra as what a report tells you, and expectation as the area under the quantile curve.
- [The Joint Slicer](../materials/joint-slicer.html) — four joints with identical marginals, plus the two-shelf mixed joint with a live posterior.
- [The Distribution Playground](../materials/distributions-playground.html) — see, sample, fit, sample from the fit (and the single-Gaussian-on-mixture trap).
- [The Likelihood Lens](../materials/likelihood-lens.html) — pdf and likelihood as two slices of one surface; draggable data with a live MLE.
- [Sampling as a Map](../materials/sampling-as-a-map.html) — ancestral sampling, then the same generator as one deterministic map; slide σ → 0 for the two-point staircase.
